//: Functions run next to the database, not next to the default region.
The Supabase project is in ap-south-1 (Mumbai). Without this key Vercel
placed every function in iad1 (Washington DC) — visible in the response
as `X-Vercel-Id: bom1::iad1::…`, an Indian edge handing the request to a
North American function. Each database round trip was then a crossing of
about 230ms, and a dashboard render makes a lot of them; the same query
measured from Mumbai answers in roughly 15ms.
bom1 is Vercel's Mumbai region, the one ap-south-1 sits in. If the
database is ever moved, this moves with it — they are one decision, and
splitting them is what the 230ms was.
